CrawlEngine with defaults scrapes a page identically to the free function

```elixir title="Elixir"
{:ok, engine} = Crawlberg.create_engine(nil)
url = "https://example.com"
result = Crawlberg.scrape_async(engine, url)
IO.inspect(result.status_code)
IO.inspect(result.content_type)
IO.inspect(result.metadata.title)
IO.inspect(result.metadata.description)
IO.inspect(length(result.links))
IO.inspect(length(result.metadata.headings))
```
